description: A harness for work on a codebase: a model is given a task, and tools to read, change and run things — in the project, or in its run's workspace where it has one — until it says it is done.

parameters.task?: string: what is to be done — where none is given, the project's own prompt
parameters.turns?: number: how often the model is asked at most (200)
parameters.forgetAt?: number: how many tokens a request may come to read before the conversation is made shorter (120000)
parameters.model?: string: the model that does the work, as provider/model — else the project's own

returns.summary?: string: what the model says it did — absent where it never said it was done
returns.asked: number: how many requests were made of the model
returns.forgotten: number: how often the conversation was made shorter by forgetting
returns.summed: number: how often by summing up

input.prompt: Say what is to be done: trama run <this project> --arg task="…"
